title: Certified binary field implementation
statement: For a natural number $\ell$, a certified binary field implementation consists of a vector $m\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$ of low coefficients and a proof that the monic polynomial specified by those coefficients is irreducible over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$.
hypotheses_covered: The modulus is a vector of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$
The polynomial specified by the modulus is irreducible
